text:
The plan fails one hard requirement.

**Fix:** pricing must depend on webhooks. Set `pricing.depends_on` to `["webhooks"]`; it is currently empty.

**Reorder:** webhooks must come before pricing in `"order"`. Use `["webhooks", "pricing", "upload", "ledger", "billing", "quota"]`.

Leave everything else unchanged. Pricing still runs before ledger, and quota still has no dependency path to pricing.
